Worktree ../c6c9-attest-split on branch c6c9-attest-split @ origin/main c3fb869ab5. Landing method: rebar/Gerrit default (push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main; LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1; Submit).

Preflight: c6c9 is a LEAF task (list-descendants empty, deps.children empty) — the rebar-implement skill's Phase 0 requires a decomposed epic, so its recursion/held-out-TDD machinery does not apply. Proceeding directly with the same discipline (claim, refactor, gates, Gerrit, close) per the operator's explicit instruction.

Seam analysis (Serena + grep, both run per AGENTS.md navigation guidance):
- Serena find_referencing_symbols(_sidecar_branch_decision) -> EXACTLY ONE reference, from remediation_mode_candidate in attest.py itself.
- Serena find_referencing_symbols(remediation_mode_candidate) -> plan_review/__init__.py::_remediation_decision + 4 test call sites, all via the attest.<name> module attribute.
- repo-wide string grep (src/ + tests/) for remediation_mode_candidate, _sidecar_branch_decision, drift_refresh_candidate, refresh_attestation, _rehash, _manifest_field, _manifest_int, current_material_fingerprint: no importlib/getattr sites; one monkeypatch.setattr(attest, 'remediation_mode_candidate', ...) at tests/unit/test_plan_review_remediation_gate.py:268.

Drift-refresh cluster REJECTED as the seam: tests/unit/test_plan_review_resign.py:98 patches attest._rehash then calls attest.refresh_attestation at :103 — moving that pair would break the patch seam. The remediation cluster has no such inward dependency.

Patch-seam preservation: the moved code resolves current_material_fingerprint / registry_version (both monkeypatched ON the attest module object) via FUNCTION-LOCAL 'from .attest import ...', which re-reads the module attribute at call time. Call sites stay byte-identical to the pre-move text.
